description: Checkbox groups are used to visually group multiple checkboxes.
title: Default

description: Use a vertical layout to display the checkboxes in a column.
title: Vertical Layout

description: Use a horizontal layout to display the checkboxes in a row.
title: Horizontal Layout

description: Use the label attribute to give the checkbox-group an accessible label. For labels that contain HTML, use the label slot instead.
title: Labels

description: Use the checked attribute on the corresponding syn-checkbox elements to set the checked state.
title: Checked

description: Add descriptive help text to a checkbox-group with the help-text attribute. For help texts that contain HTML, use the help-text slot instead.The help-text attribute should not be used to display error messages. To handle validation and error messaging, use syn-validate for proper error management.
title: Help Text

description: The focus event gives the user feedback that one of the Checkboxes has been focused by the keyboard interaction.
title: Focus

description: Set disabled on individual syn-checkbox options that are unavailable, and explain why. The checkbox group itself has no disabled attribute.
title: Disabled

description: Set readonly on each syn-checkbox whose checked state users should inspect but not change. To freeze the entire group, apply it to every option, not just the checked ones.
title: Readonly

description: The size of checkboxes will be determined by the checkbox group’s size attribute.
title: Sizes
